faq.q: Do AI UGC ads work?
faq.a: For cold traffic and finding the winning angle, yes. The skill cites one operator's $100K test (220 videos): human UGC had the higher CTR and AI the higher ROAS, because AI made more variants cheaply. It is weak for high-ticket offers and warm audiences.

faq.q: Are AI UGC ads legal?
faq.a: The AI creator may demo the product and state facts, but never give a first-person testimonial or result ("I used it for two weeks..."): the FTC bans fake testimonials, AI ones included, and New York requires a synthetic-performer disclosure. ai-ad-compliance-check returns the rule and a rewrite for each line. Not legal advice.

faq.q: Can I use AI UGC on TikTok Shop?
faq.a: Not as the presenter. TikTok Shop rules ban an AI voice standing in for the presenter, so the skill stops and hands over to tiktok-shop-video, which uses AI only for b-roll under a real person.

faq.q: Why does my AI UGC look fake?
faq.a: Usually waxy skin, perfect light and an unreadable label. The skill writes real skin details (pores, flyaway hairs), prompts phone flaws (handheld tremor, autofocus hunts, phone-mic audio), uses a straight-on product photo with a readable label, and rejects clips whose face, label or hand count drift.

faq.q: Seedance 2.5 or Kling 4 for AI UGC?

faq.q: How do I keep the same face and product in every clip?
